messages:
irene: heads up — we started seeing SSO logins succeed but users landing with the wrong role (Viewer instead of Admin) for a subset of tenants after last night's RBAC rename. Noticed spike ~03:10 UTC. @samir @kevin can you take a look? :warning:

samir: saw it too, reproducing. Okta reports the SAML assertion arrived, but our role array in the decoded assertion is truncated (ends mid-array). looks like the signed attribute chunk got cut. Sample from one affected assertion below.

samir: ```
...<Attribute Name=\"roles\">[\"Admin\",\"Infra\",\"Audit\"]</Attribute>...
-- truncated --
```

kevin: interesting — we rotated the SAML signing key yesterday at 02:50 UTC as part of the RBAC rollout. If signature verification fails we fall back to a legacy parsing path that strips out signedAttributes. checking KMS and key rotation logs now.

tara: can someone paste the Okta mapping rule for roles and a couple of audit log lines for the failed assignments? need to prove whether the attribute was lost before reaching our RBAC service or dropped during verification.

irene: pasted mapping snippet and one audit line. mapping rule in Okta for this app is: ```
user.roles -> app.saml.attributes.roles
if user.extra.roles then append user.extra.roles
```

irene: audit line from our ingestion (redacted): ```
{\"ts\":\"2026-11-05T03:11:38Z\",\"user\":\"u@example.com\",\"event\":\"sso.login\",\"saml_present\":true,\"saml_roles\":null,\"assigned_role\":\"viewer\",\"tenant\":\"acme-corp\"}
```

audit-bot: detected 42 similar events across 3 tenants between 03:09-03:15 UTC where `saml_roles` was null but `saml_present` true. Marked for investigation.

devops-bot: deploy: infra/rbac-rollout v2.1 finished 2026-11-05T02:50Z (includes rename of role Admin->PlatformAdmin).

mika: quick workaround: add a transient mapping in Okta to map by `memberOf` or `entitlement` claim when `roles` attr missing. That buys time while we diagnose signed attr handling. will temp-enable for affected tenants if ops approves. :+1:

samir: two possible roots: 1) assertion size + chunking in Okta -> attribute splitting; 2) our verification path after key rotation drops signedAttributes. kevin, if KMS shows rotation at 02:50 and any verification errors around 03:10 that's likely. fallback path is aggressive. we should patch to fallback to unsigned attribute parsing if signed attr is missing rather than dropping all roles.

kevin: confirmed KMS rotated key id `saml-v2-2026-11-05` at 2026-11-05T02:50:21Z. I see ~20 signature verification failures from the verifier service between 03:09-03:12 due to stale cached key on a small subset of verifier instances. creating hotfix to reload keys and relax signed-attr drop. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rbac/commit/abc123

kevin: patch diff (snippet): ```diff
- if (!signed_attrs) reject_assertion();
+ if (!signed_attrs) log.warn('signed attrs missing, falling back to unsigned parsing')
+  parsed_roles = parse_unsigned_attr(assertion, 'roles')
```

irene: OK — applying temporary Okta mapping for affected tenants now (mika please coordinate). rolling back the RBAC rename for the two tenants showing persistent failures until the verifier hotfix is deployed. will monitor audit-bot alerts.

mika: coordinated with Okta admin, transient mapping live for acme-corp + beta-inc. monitoring.

kevin: hotfix merged to main and promoted to canary verifiers. need a quick smoke: @irene can you verify an affected user now?

irene: verified with one test user — role assignment back to Admin for the test case. rolling out fix to remaining verifiers. will close thread when all tenants green. :white_check_mark:

samir: follow-ups: 1) add a metric for `signed_attr_missing` + alert; 2) add a KMS key-rotation checklist step to invalidate verifier caches; 3) backfill audit logs for windows where `saml_roles` was null so we can notify affected customers.

irene: capturing follow-ups in security/infra retro doc. thanks all. :pray:
